description: Take control , take action and move on 🥂 #moveon #selfimprovement #selfacceptance
transcript: You are in full control. There is nothing that cannot change until you are ready. Yes, things happen. Life is life. We experience turmoil. This life was never meant to be pain-free, but it is meant for you to take responsibility and to take action. Your life belongs to you. You get to decide which road that you want to travel.
